records.issue_text: [Medium/security] apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:52 — Decrypted JSON is persisted without validation against the selected app's credential schema, allowing arbitrary or malformed credential data to reach downstream integrations.
records.rationale: Verified in the diff: app-credential.ts decrypts and does `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, ...))` then persists `key: keys` directly via prisma.credential.update/create with no validation against the app's credential schema (e.g., googleCredentialSchema), unlike other credential paths in this diff which zod-parse token responses.
